source_capture.authority_method: AuthorityClient.prepare_native_event(full_request_body, parent_receipt_handles=(), purpose, intent_id, trace_id, retry_index=0); current daemon registration remains fail-closed until the enrolled producer/gateway and root observer are composed.
source_capture.classification: private/unknown only; no human-origin or public clearance
source_capture.retry_index_header_semantics: Root-derived bounded decimal transport claim; gateway passes it to the root, which must compare it with the one-use event's stored retry index.
source_capture.tool_result_source: unavailable; generic worker capture_source is retired and root-observed effect-result source issuance is not composed.
source_capture.native_package_binding: root-selected no-argument bind_selected_native_package plus read_native_resolver; resolver rows are presentation only, never effect grants
source_capture.attempt_semantics: Fresh complete SDK request-envelope capture and opaque bridge handle per attempt. The gateway returns only a root-created X-Hermes-Native-Response-Ref; worker hashes raw response bytes and calls the same-peer root metadata getter before exposing any root-observed tool call binding to lexical Hermes dispatch.
limits: Native provider and response-delivery service composition, producer/gateway enrollment, and current root invocation-context getter remain unavailable in this checkout.
Response metadata is accepted only after authenticated root lookup binds opaque response ref, exact raw bytes digest and original native request handle.
Changed-envelope upstream fallback chains do not yet carry explicit root retry admission.
The root has not recorded a root-observed native loader-ready/action event; the package mount proof alone does not establish plugin import or use.
Do not enable native provider egress or native plugin effects until root role enrollment, observer, invocation, and result-source paths are composed and tested.

response_delivery.lookup_header: X-Hermes-Native-Response-Ref carries only an opaque root-created one-use lookup reference; it is never itself source authority.
response_delivery.digest_domain: SHA-256 of exact dechunked, identity-encoded HTTP response entity bytes; require one Content-Length and exact byte-count equality. Streaming hashes the full captured SSE entity before accepting metadata.
response_delivery.worker_behavior: The pinned SDK hook reads the raw response header/body, correlates the request handle consumed from the immediately preceding provider prepare seam, and installs call bindings only after the authenticated root lookup returns matching digest and request handle.
response_delivery.model_content: No response metadata is read from model fields, parsed tool arguments, response body extras or ordinary headers.

transport_controls.SDK_automatic_retries: forced to zero for primary request-scoped OpenAI clients and patched auxiliary OpenAI clients; Hermes-observed attempts require a fresh native event
transport_controls.request_timeout: clamped to the live host-issued event lease before SDK call
transport_controls.retry_admission: only exact-envelope repeats retain intent and increment retry_index; changed-envelope retries require an explicit host retry-admission integration
